descriptions.d10b_filter_property_text_80271348: Compact a mutable NUL-terminated byte string in place, keeping printable ASCII 32 through 126 except ampersand; write a terminator when the original string is nonempty. Dispatch the filtered text and original editor to string/vector/integer/float/color/name handlers for kinds 20,21,24,25,22,34 respectively; leave other kinds without a handler call. Preserve byte unsigned comparisons and case order. Partial editor field view; no owned initialized data.
